what_this_is: Price statistics measured on archived product pages of the reference distributor, for alexander-marquardt/synthetic-industrial-products#52 step 1. Derived figures only: no page, SKU, title or brand name ships.

method.sources: Product-group pages (one archived page lists a series: one brand, one material, many sizes, each row with its shown price and sale unit) for every deep type except end mills; single-item pages for end mills, whose group pages are not archived.
method.price: The price the page SHOWS a signed-out visitor, with its sale unit ('/ each', '/ pkg. of 10'). per_piece = price / pack quantity.
method.dedupe: One record per SKU per type; the latest capture wins.
method.key_dimension: The first spec attribute in the type's list that parses to a number; inch fractions, #-gauge screw numbers (0.060 + 0.013 n), M-sizes and mm are converted to inches, weights to ounces.
method.slope: Pooled within-cell OLS of log(per_piece) on log(key dimension). A cell is one group page (or one brand) with every non-dimension attribute equal; fasteners also hold length equal. Monotonicity counts every within-cell pair whose key dimension differs.
method.brand_spread: A 'spec' is the key dimension plus the type's spec-defining attributes (material, flutes, grit, closure...). For each spec offered by two or more brands: max/min of the per-brand median per-piece price. brand_price_index = a brand's median per-piece price relative to the spec's geometric mean, over the specs it shares. house_label_over_other_brands compares the distributor's own labels to the other brands on shared specs.
method.low_confidence: true when n < 30; read those figures as indicative only.
method.price_basis: Which price an entry measured (#92). 'regular_price': a row that shows a clearance price beside its regular price is priced at the regular price (the two #69 entries, whose parser is scripts/price_census_parse.py). 'shown_price_clearance_unmeasured': #57's method, the price the page shows, which on a clearance row is the clearance price; #57's parser was never committed, so whether its rows are on the regular price cannot be shown, and its 2015 entries carry the clearance-price signature. Do not compare or pool price levels across the two values until the #57 entries are re-measured under the regular-price rule.

capture_eras.note: Mostly 2015 group-page captures; some 2016, 2017 and 2020 group pages; end-mill item pages are 2020-2021 captures. Each type carries its own capture_years. Prices are nominal for their capture year and are not inflation-adjusted. Pages served as script shells with no item rows (all four ball-pein hammer group pages, two jobber-drill and two spiral-point-tap group pages among them) were discarded.
